00System overview

Every lead source runs into one agent. Nothing falls out of the system.

Your site says to call or text you directly, and your FAQ promises every minute is one-on-one with you, never an aide. That's exactly why new patients slip through: you can't pick up the phone halfway through a 75-minute evaluation. The engine keeps your personal touch and covers the gap. New ad leads, past patients and every missed call land with one AI agent that replies in seconds, in Duende's voice, and books the $49 assessment. Anyone who doesn't book, no-shows or finishes care gets recycled back into reactivation instead of forgotten.

01Ads

Ads built around the patients you're best at helping

Your own Instagram videos would be the strongest ads you have, and in a real launch we'd cut them into ads first. For this preview we took three proven formats from our ad library and rebuilt them around Duende and your real Google reviews: two UGC-style videos for people stuck in the same cycle of pain, and a review card from a patient you helped through C-section recovery. In a launch we test them and double down on whatever books the most assessments.

02Funnel

Why ads go to a funnel, not your website

duendephysicaltherapy.com is a beautiful site and it should stay: your story, the full list of what you treat, your values, a thorough FAQ. That's perfect for someone researching. Someone who just clicked an ad needs one thing: a reason to book and an easy way to do it.

01

Only what matters

Just the information that gets someone to book: their problem, your approach, real reviews, what the visit covers and what it costs. Nothing else.

02

No distractions

No 70-condition list, no menu, no links away. Every extra page is a chance for them to wander off and forget about you.

03

One choice: book

Too many options causes decision paralysis. Every button on the page does the same thing: book the $49 assessment.

duendephysicaltherapy.com/assessment
  • Headline matches the ad they clicked
  • Six real Google reviews up front
  • Price, insurance and the internal exam answered early
  • One action: the $49 assessment
03AI appointment agent

An agent that answers while you're with a patient

The practice that replies first usually wins the patient, and you can't text back in the middle of a 75-minute evaluation. This agent replies to every lead in seconds, answers questions from your own website, handles the insurance, superbill and internal-exam questions with the same care you do, and books the assessment.

  • Knows your conditions, pricing, superbills and FAQ
  • Never gives medical advice or invents details
  • Offers two open times and books the one they pick
  • Hands off to you whenever it should

LIVE · TRY ITAsk it anything a new patient would. It already knows Duende's services from your website.

04Database reactivation

Turn the people you already know into booked visits

Every past patient and every person who asked about care but never booked is already on your list. Regular email and SMS campaigns bring them back, at almost no cost per booking.

SMS campaign
SENDTo old leads and past patients, every few months
Hi Sam, it's Duende Physical Therapy. It's been a while since your last visit, how are things feeling? I opened a few $49 assessment spots this month if anything has crept back.
honestly my hip has been acting up again since I started lifting. anything next week?
Email campaign
SENDMonthly, to the whole list
Duende Physical TherapyStill dealing with it?
Hi Sarah, A while back you reached out about pelvic pain. If it's still with you, I'd love to help you figure out what's driving it. Every visit at Duende is one-on-one with me, never an aide or a tech. We go at your pace, and anything internal is always optional. Reply to this email or text me to book a $49 assessment: 75 minutes to talk it all through, a hands-on assessment and a plan built around your goals. Dr. Natalia Martinez, DPT Duende Physical Therapy
05Nothing leaks

06The guarantee

7-10 paid assessments within your first 30 days, guaranteed.

You've built a practice with 47 five-star reviews and a waitlist mindset. This puts it in front of more of the right people in the East Bay and makes sure every one of them gets an answer. Here's what we commit to.

01

We work until it's hit

If you get fewer than 7, we keep running your campaigns and you pay no booking fees until you've received them. No renegotiation.

02

Pay per booking, never a retainer

Our fees are waived for your first 30 days. After that you pay only for paid assessments, and you keep the $49 every patient pays.

03

Prepaid patients show up

Every patient pays when they book, so you get people who are serious, higher show rates and a payment record for every booking.
